sources.excerpt: The Cavernous interior of the Temple enshrines a huge ‘lingam’.

Sacred account associates Rama with passage towards Panchabati in Dandakaranya; incomplete source grammar does not establish foundation chronology.

District mentions Shabari; do not conflate its river account with Tourism Kolab wording.

sources.title: Bats in a cave tourism and pilgrimage site in eastern India: conservation challenges
sources.author: Subrat Debata
sources.locator: Abstract; Study area; Methods/Bat surveys; Results/Reproductive phenology and Visitation; Discussion; publisher bibliographic metadata
sources.access: Original publisher HTML inspected through web tool and directHTTP200 retrieval. Online25November2020; Oryx55(5),September2021,pp684–691. CC BY4.0 shown; no PDF inspection claimed.
sources.excerpt: The study was carried out over 12 months during September 2016–August 2017
claims: Five caves surveyed September2016–August2017, with visits on2consecutive days/month; bats and tourists examined on different days.
Eight bat species recorded across cave system; breeding recorded in five duringFebruary–July.
Heavier festival visitation overlapped with reproductive period.
Author recommended crowd management, less unnecessary illumination and restriction around maternity colonies during breeding.
limits: Historical fieldwork; no present census, current rules, decline proved by visitor correlation, or guaranteed bat sightings.
Overall monthly bat count was not significantly correlated with visitor numbers; do not imply demonstrated visitor-caused decline.
No sensitive roost coordinates, mapped maternity locations or caving directions published.
Cited secondary general ecology claims not reused as independently inspected original studies.
